verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing explicitly claims it can prevent non-production environments from accessing production services, which matches the story directly. A related claim says private networking keeps internal traffic off the public internet. The support is only a one-line claim with no documentation of how the isolation is configured, scoped, or enforced. Missing for 10: configuration docs for environment isolation, details on enforcement scope (services, datastores, private network), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
